Lemma
[Directional derivatives of convex functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0449, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0450, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0451 ↗ def:chow-iii-h22-directional-derivative 1. apph:H.25\group Directional derivatives

For convex $f$, $J_{s_1}(V)\le J_{s_2}(V)$ when $0<s_1\le s_2$, so $D_Vf$ exists in $[-\infty ,\infty )$. If $f$ is locally $L$-Lipschitz, then \[ |J_s(V)|\le L|V|,\qquad |D_Vf|\le L|V|, \] and if both $V$ and $-V$ are admissible then $-D_{-V}f\le D_Vf$.
